Opp. Party(s)
 ---
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---
For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Adv.

For the State : Mrs. Kumari Rashmi, A.P.P.
 ---
04/15.03.2024: Heard the parties.
2.

The applicant(s), who is an accused for the offence under Sections 498A/ 341, 323, 504, 506/34 IPC, pray(s) for anticipatory bail expressing apprehension of arrest in connection with Chhipadohar P.S. Case No.27 of 2022 (G.R. No.167 of 2023), pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M, Latehar.
3. It appears that earlier anticipatory bail application of the applicant has been dismissed as withdrawn.
It further appears that this applicant is Devar and he is harassing his Bhabhi, who is informant in the present case and not allowing her to enter the matrimonial house.
4. Considering the nature of dispute, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant provisionally for six months.

Accordingly, the applicant(s) above named is/are directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from today and on his/her/their surrender, the applicant(s) be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M, Latehar, in connection with above referred case, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
5. List this case on 18.09.2024.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Ravi/-
